author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Original: two slanted outlined capsules then a larger circle above a smaller circle. Rejected drawing: the small circle was an r3 ring whose hole collapsed to a pinhole (reads as a blob), and the bars sat too close to the rings.
change: Kept the two parallel slanted bars (shared vector, pitch 10) and redrew the circles as an r6 ring over an r5 ring (smallest ring with an open 6-unit hole), each 8 clear of the other and of the second bar.
visual_review: Compared with the original; checked 48px light and dark previews: both rings show open holes, bars parallel, four parts distinct.
construction_references: Lucide circle (ring construction); no closer Lucide match
omissions: capsule outlines of the bars reduced to single strokes (width budget)
